name: NVIDIA Magpie TTS Multilingual
purpose: Dedicated speech-generation layer for voice agents: converts LLM text to speech in 12 languages with five fixed English-trained speaker voices, not for zero-shot cloning (card).

license.name: NVIDIA Open Model License
license.notes: Agreement text read (nvidia.com): "Models are commercially usable. You are free to create and distribute Derivative Models."; redistribution needs the agreement and the Notice "Licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model License". Card forbids use outside the 12 languages only as "not intended".

architecture.kind: AUTOREGRESSIVE transformer encoder-decoder over multi-codebook audio codec tokens (typically 8 codebooks, frame stacking)
architecture.why_this_design: Card: end-to-end encoder-decoder that plugs into cascaded voice-agent pipelines without changing the upstream LLM.

engine_support.notes: Card: optimized for NVIDIA GPUs; AMD path unknown.

strengths: tiny, built for latency in voice agents
German trained on CML-TTS German and a desktop speech corpus

tona_fit.reason: Open license, tiny, German supported, but a fixed small voice set, no cloning, and an NVIDIA-optimised NeMo stack with no known AMD/GGML path. Worth watching for a voice-agent product; no independent German quality evidence.

open_questions: Is there a GGML/ONNX port that runs on AMD?
